value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks partly sunny, with a high around 65°F (the other forecasts run 64 to 67). Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, shifting east to northeast in the afternoon with gusts up to 17 mph. Rain may move in Tuesday evening, about a 30% chance after 3 p.m., and it picks up through the night. Lows will be in the low 40s to 30s.
